GENERAL NOTES / NOTE GENERALI

  1. Period of performance. The contract will consist of one 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods (PWS para 1.6). Workload in this exhibit applies to all periods unless changed by modification.
  2. Units of measure. All floor and ground areas in this exhibit are stated in metric units as recorded by the U.S. and host nation real property offices: square meters (SM, m², mq) and hectares (ha). No area in this exhibit is stated in square feet. Offerors are responsible for any conversion used in pricing (1 m² = 10.7639 SF; 1 ha = 10,000 m² = 2.47105 acres).
  3. Number format. Table 3-1 is an extract from the U.S. inventory and uses the U.S. number format (2,148.6 SM). Tables 3-2, 3-3 and 3-4 were furnished by the host nation and are reproduced as received, in the Italian format: the period separates thousands and the comma separates decimals (4.312,8 m² = 4,312.8 SM; 3.460 mq = 3,460 SM).
  4. Area definitions. GROSS AREA (SM) / SUPERFICIE LORDA is the gross floor area of all floors measured to the outside face of exterior walls. CLEANABLE AREA (SM) / SUPERFICIE NETTA PULIBILE is the net area to be serviced under PWS para 5.2 (Custodial Services). Where no cleanable area is given, the gross area applies.
  5. Floors / Piani. PT = piano terra (ground floor); S1 = piano interrato (basement level); “PT+2” = ground floor plus two upper floors (three floors in all); “S1+PT+2” = four levels.
  6. Service frequency. 7X/WK or 7/7 = seven days per week; 5X/WK or 5/7 = Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal and Italian national holidays; 3/7, 2/7, 1/7 = three, two or one service day(s) per week; 2 v/sett. = twice weekly; settimanale = weekly; quindicinale = every two weeks.
  7. Exclusions. Facilities marked USO ITALIANO are under Italian Army (Comando Caserma) control and are not in the scope of this contract. Facilities marked DA DEMOLIRE FY27 are programmed for demolition and shall not be priced. Both are listed for reference only and are included in the SUBTOTALE rows.
  8. Totals. SUBTOTALE and TOTALE rows are provided for information only and are not additional facilities.
  9. Access. Contractor personnel require installation access badges issued by the USAG Italy Directorate of Emergency Services and shall comply with Italian labor and safety law (D.Lgs. 81/2008) in addition to the PWS.
